verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right with a clear centred headline and a prominent RSVP button, but the FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES pills overlap each other, the missing-asset placeholder is clipped at the top-right edge, and the legal text floats awkwardly mid-canvas under the subhead. B demotes the CTA to a small pill the same size as the info badges, which buries it. It also crams the italic subhead into a narrow four-line column, leaves the logo wordmark broken ('SOLST CE') and jams the date, URL and legal text into scattered fragments, so its hierarchy and grouping are worse.
